as_told.title: Farmington Armada witness: too many to count

plain: In 1950, in Farmington, a town in New Mexico, people say huge numbers of silver discs flew over the sky. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that half the town watched hundreds of these discs swarm overhead. He says it came to be known as the Farmington Armada. An unnamed witness also speaks on the show from their own memory. The witness says that on the first day there were only a few objects, and on the second day there were too many to count. So the host gives the broad picture and the witness gives the day by day detail, which, if true, would make it one of the largest mass sightings ever.
